analysis: Both units are CHANGELOG.md-only (documentation) hunks: lines 398-604 and 605 onward. No executable code, config, or mode/rename changes are present, so there are no direct security regressions in this PR. The text describes behavior in several existing areas: the TB-011 App Attest serving authorization and revocation work (T-052 to T-058), unauthenticated attestation roster privacy (T-058), the SSD prefix cache disk budget and TTL (T-041/SEC-035), and the admin OTP JSON encoding fix (T-026). The entries are consistent with the canonical threat model and do not contradict its stated assumptions. The SSD disk budget (available disk/2 without a fixed ceiling) matches the T-041 text. The changelog's 'the 15 minute TTL' is not restated here; the model records 30 minutes since 2026-09-26, and nothing in this diff widens it. One minor gap: T-041 says releases through v0.9.10 delete the retired kv/ files in a startup sweep, which is beyond what these hunks show. This is not verifiable from the supplied excerpts. Because only prose changed, the real code behind these claims was not supplied. A later pass should review the code diffs, if any exist in this PR, for the App Attest, revocation fencing, and prefix-cache behavior described. Nothing here establishes that the described mitigations are implemented.
